import sys, json, time, itertools, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from validate import validate
from adaptive2 import run_one

def scenario(name, links, parts, dem, period, env):
    cmds=[{"op":"load","n":max(max(u,v) for u,v,_ in links)+1,"links":[[u,v,c] for u,v,c in links],"bookings":[]}]
    for i,(p,d) in enumerate(zip(parts,dem)):
        cmds.append({"op":"prepare","id":f"p{i}","owner":"o","window":[0,period*10],"period":period,
                     "participants":p,"envelope":env,"rev":i})
    return cmds

# tight 4-cycle: links ab2, bd1, dc2, ca1 ; all four participants demand 1
links=[(0,1,2),(1,3,1),(3,2,2),(2,0,1)]
cmds=scenario("cycle4", links, [[0,1,2,3]], [1], 1, [[0,1],[1,1],[2,1],[3,1]])
t0=time.time(); reps=run_one(cmds); dt=time.time()-t0
problems=[]; validate(cmds,reps,problems)
print("cycle4:", json.dumps(reps[-1])[:150], f"{dt:.2f}s", problems)

# star with participant center: needs cap 2 on each leaf link
links=[(0,1,2),(0,2,2),(0,3,2)]
cmds=scenario("star", links, [[0,1,2,3]], [1], 1, [[0,1],[1,1],[2,1]])
t0=time.time(); reps=run_one(cmds); dt=time.time()-t0
problems=[]; validate(cmds,reps,problems)
print("star:", json.dumps(reps[-1])[:150], f"{dt:.2f}s", problems)

# star too small -> should be denied by cut
links=[(0,1,1),(0,2,1),(0,3,1)]
cmds=scenario("star-small", links, [[0,1,2,3]], [1], 1, [[0,1],[1,1],[2,1]])
t0=time.time(); reps=run_one(cmds); dt=time.time()-t0
problems=[]; validate(cmds,reps,problems)
print("star-small:", json.dumps(reps[-1])[:170], f"{dt:.2f}s", problems)

# random sparse with non-participants, moderate capacity
random.seed(4)
n=12
allp=list(itertools.combinations(range(n),2)); random.shuffle(allp)
links=[(u,v,random.choice([3,4,6,10])) for (u,v) in allp[:20]]
parts=sorted(random.sample(range(n),6))
cmds=scenario("rand12", links, [parts], [1], 10, [[l,1] for l in range(len(links))])
t0=time.time(); reps=run_one(cmds); dt=time.time()-t0
problems=[]; validate(cmds,reps,problems)
r=reps[-1]
print("rand12:", r.get('status'), r.get('kind',''), (str(r.get('cut'))[:60] if r.get('cut') else (len(r['plan']['trees']) if 'plan' in r else '')), f"{dt:.2f}s", problems)
PYEOF
